criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Card Usage & Acceptance
categories.definition: Queries about where and how a card can be used, including contactless payments.

categories.name: Card Order & Delivery
categories.definition: Queries about obtaining a new card, virtual card, additional cards, or the delivery status of a card.

categories.name: Card Management
categories.definition: Queries about managing an existing card, including activation, PIN, expiry, replacement, or freezing.

categories.name: Lost or Stolen Card/Device
categories.definition: Queries about a lost or stolen card or device and related security actions.

categories.name: Account Management
categories.definition: Queries about opening, closing, updating personal details, identity verification, or general account security.

categories.name: Add Funds (Top-up/Deposit)
categories.definition: Queries about adding money to an account or card, including methods, limits, and issues with deposits.

categories.name: Money Transfers
categories.definition: Queries about sending or receiving money transfers, their status, issues, or cancellation.

categories.name: Payments & Refunds
categories.definition: Queries about general payments, declined payments, unauthorized transactions, direct debits, or requesting refunds.

categories.name: Fees & Charges
categories.definition: Queries about understanding or disputing specific fees or charges on an account or transaction.

categories.name: Cash Withdrawal & ATM Issues
categories.definition: Queries about withdrawing cash from ATMs, issues with the amount received, or ATM functionality.

categories.name: Currency Exchange
categories.definition: Queries about exchanging currencies, exchange rates, or supported currencies.

categories.name: Card Malfunction
categories.definition: Queries about a card not working or being declined due to a technical issue, not related to usage limits or fraud.

categories.name: App & Login Issues
categories.definition: Queries about problems accessing the app or account, including password resets.

categories.name: General Product Information
categories.definition: Queries seeking general information about how a product or feature works.
